title: How finance teams use Claude Cowork
description: Watch Claude take on the finance work that eats up your close and your quarter. We'll show how FP&A and controllership teams (including Anthropic’s own finance team!) are using Claude Cowork across forecasting, variance, close, and consolidations , and answer your questions on what it looks like to actually roll it out.

segments.text: Deploying agentic systems transforms developer and team workflows by automating high-friction tasks. Organizations scale safely by pairing automated tool orchestration with structured human review.
